title: Cinta Kaz
subtitle: Rebel
description: Cinta Kaz was deceptively young and small in stature, with her main strength using her enemies overconfidence to help formulate her attacks. While in a relationship with Mon Mothma's cousin, and fellow rebel warrior, Vel Sartha, the mission at hand always came first and was always top priority, especially when it came to fighting against the tyranny of the Empire.
